'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Red Sea crisis]]
**[[Attacks on the MV Tutor|Attacks on the MV ''Tutor'']]
***The [[Liberia]]-flagged MV ''Tutor'' sinks in the [[Red Sea]] six days after being attacked by a [[Houthi]] [[unmanned surface vessel]] and [[missile]]. [https://apnews.com/article/houthi-rebels-ship-attack-red-sea-yemen-bfa7d321e55c5bb59b268b82ef3c56ba (AP)]
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Russian strikes against Ukrainian infrastructure (2022–present)|Russian strikes against Ukrainian infrastructure]]
***[[Ukraine]] experiences [[rolling blackout]]s due to [[Russia]]n attacks on power plants across the country. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/6/19/russia-ukraine-war-list-of-key-events-day-845 (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Korean conflict]]
**[[Republic of Korea Armed Forces|South Korean soldiers]] fire warning shots at [[Korean People's Army|North Korean soldiers]] who crossed the [[Military Demarcation Line|Demarcation Line]], apparently in error. It is the second such incident at the demarcation line in the past month. [https://apnews.com/article/north-korea-south-korea-border-tensions-warning-shots-2aa0eaef30dbc5801d5e787205b577a0 (AP)]
**[[North Korea]]n troop casualties are reported following landmine explosions in the [[Korean Demilitarized Zone]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/article/2024/jun/18/north-korea-troop-casualties-reported-after-landmine-explosions-in-dmz (''The Guardian'')]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Nvidia]] surpasses [[Microsoft]] as the world's [[List of public corporations by market capitalization|most valuable publicly-traded company]] after its [[Market capitalization|market cap]] exceeds US$3.34 trillion. [https://www.cnbc.com/2024/06/18/nvidia-passes-microsoft-in-market-cap-is-most-valuable-public-company.html (NBC News)]
*The [[United States Department of Agriculture]] announces a temporary suspension on imports of mangoes and avocados from [[Michoacán]], [[Mexico]], after an incident that reportedly caused security concerns for safety inspectors. [https://abcnews.go.com/GMA/Food/usda-pauses-avocado-mango-inspections-mexican-state-due/story?id=111207741 (ABC News)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2024 Hajj disaster]]
**More than 577 pilgrims from [[Jordan]], [[Egypt]], [[Tunisia]], and [[Indonesia]] are confirmed to have died of heat-related illnesses during the [[Hajj]] in [[Saudi Arabia]]. [https://www.jordantimes.com/news/local/number-jordanian-pilgrims-who-die-heat-exhaustion-during-hajj-confirmed-41#google_vignette (''The Jordan Times'')] [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/saudi-arabia-hajj-egyptian-jordanian-pilgrims-die-mecca/ (CBS News)] [https://www.sharjah24.ae/en/Articles/2024/06/18/a5 (Sharjah 24)] [https://www.bernama.com/en/world/news.php?id=2308999 (Bernama)]
*[[2024 New Mexico wildfires]]
**At least one person dies, over 500 structures are damaged or destroyed, and several thousand people are forced to evacuate from [[Ruidoso]], [[New Mexico]], United States, after the South Fork Fire burns over 15,276 acres of land. [https://apnews.com/article/new-mexico-wildfire-ruidoso-evacuation-86ee7230cc09ed7922a8f3a3815c7e7c# (AP)]
*At least nine people are killed and 15 others are missing during [[landslide]]s caused by [[flood]]s in [[Guangdong]] and [[Fujian]] provinces, [[China]]. [https://apnews.com/article/china-floods-wuping-guangdong-landslides-84a64590387f4dff38f5da9d0768a6ee (AP)]
*Nine people are killed in a fire caused by an electric [[short circuit]] at a hospital in [[Rasht]], [[Iran]]. [https://apnews.com/article/iran-fire-hospital-rasht-9d21b0529a1403041c7cbf509c27e286 (AP)]
*At least four people are killed and more than 120 others are injured by a magnitude 5.0 earthquake in [[Kashmar]], [[Iran]]. [https://www.iranintl.com/en/202406181202 (''Iran International'')]

'''International relations'''
*[[China–Ecuador relations]]
**[[Ecuador]]'s [[List of ministers of foreign affairs of Ecuador|foreign ministry]] announces that it is reinstating a visa requirement for travelers from [[China]], citing an increase in irregular migratory flows from China. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/ecuador-reinstates-visa-requirement-chinese-travelers-2024-06-18/ (Reuters)]
*[[Israel–Kosovo relations]]
**[[Israel]] and [[Kosovo]] agree to allow their citizens reciprocal visa-free travel. [https://apnews.com/article/kosovo-israel-visa-waiver-entry-2cbfbd603629d150693d6692ae243450 (AP)]
*[[Sweden–United States relations]]
**The [[Riksdag|Swedish Parliament]] votes 266–37 to adopt a defense agreement with the [[United States]], giving the [[United States Armed Forces|U.S. military]] access to 17 military bases and training areas in [[Sweden]], including for weapon and military equipment storage. [https://www.lemonde.fr/en/international/article/2024/06/19/swedish-mps-green-light-to-controversial-us-defense-deal_6675128_4. (''Le Monde'')]

'''Law and crime''' 
*[[Lèse-majesté in Thailand]]
**Former [[Prime Minister of Thailand]] [[Thaksin Shinawatra]] is indicted on a charge of royal [[defamation]]. [https://apnews.com/article/thailand-thaksin-lese-majeste-srettha-move-forward-a3b4bfee63f4ed547fffe2ff153fd0b4 (AP)]
*A court in [[Iran]] sentences [[Nobel Peace Prize]] laureate [[Narges Mohammadi]] to one year in prison for propaganda against the state. [https://english.alarabiya.net/News/middle-east/2024/06/18/iran-slaps-one-year-prison-term-on-nobel-winner-narges-mohammadi-lawyer (Al Arabiya)]
*[[Kazakhstan|Kazakh]] opposition activist Aydos Sadykov is shot and injured in [[Kyiv]], [[Ukraine]]. [https://www.rferl.org/a/sadyqov-kazakh-opposition-activist-shot-kyiv/32997954.html (Radio Free Europe)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[LGBT rights in Thailand]], [[Recognition of same-sex unions in Thailand]]
**The [[Senate of Thailand]] passes a marriage equality bill that will legalize [[same-sex marriage]] in [[Thailand|the country]], with the bill now awaiting [[royal assent]]. [https://edition.cnn.com/2024/06/18/asia/thailand-same-sex-marriage-intl-hnk/index.html (CNN)]

'''Sports'''
*[[Regan Smith (swimmer)|Regan Smith ]] breaks the [[World record progression 100 metres backstroke|100 metres backstroke world record]] at the [[2024 United States Olympic trials (swimming)|US Olympic Swimming Trials]] in [[Indianapolis]], [[Indiana]], United States.
